subject: PO field gating & legal clearance for Coupa onboarding / MSA redlines
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@healthspan.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: HealthSpan Procurement <procurement@healthspan.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor registration + MSA redline for Redwood

Morning Michael,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We're ready to start vendor registration in Coupa and to get an executed MSA + order form in place. Attached are three files: our internal PO mapping (Excel), and a copy of the MSA with a few redlines from our legal team.

Two asks to get us moving:
1) Can your onboarding team confirm which PO fields Redwood requires in Coupa (particularly: PO number, bill-to, remit-to, tax ID, and any custom account codes)?
2) Do you support SFTP drop for invoices or do you require EDI/punchout? If SFTP, we'll provision an account once we have the correct host/user details.

I've attached HealthSpan_PO_Mapping.xlsx and HealthSpan_MSA_Redline_20260921.docx for reference.

If convenient, propose a short call Thursday to align on fields and timeline.

Best,
Jordan Lee
Director, Vendor Ops
HealthSpan

Attachments: HealthSpan_PO_Mapping.xlsx (xlsx), HealthSpan_MSA_Redline_20260921.docx (docx)

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@healthspan.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + MSA redline for Redwood

Jordan — thanks for sending these over. We're excited to get HealthSpan onboarded. Quick responses to your asks:

- We'll review the MSA redlines with Legal and get back with comments by end of day.
- For Coupa registration, the core PO fields Redwood requires are: PO number, line item qty/price, bill-to site, remit-to account, vendor tax ID (EIN), and a 6-digit internal GL code (optional but preferred).
- We support two invoice ingestion paths: Coupa -> API (preferred) or SFTP drop. We do not require EDI for initial onboarding.

Marissa — looping you in to coordinate the redline review. Kimberly / Vivek — can you confirm whether the GL code field will be enforced at registration or can be a later mapping after activation? Also flag any Coupa admin requirements.

I can host a 30-minute alignment call Thursday 9/23 at 9:00am PT if that works for HealthSpan.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@healthspan.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + MSA redline for Redwood

Michael / Jordan — I reviewed HealthSpan's redline and added inline comments in the attached doc (HealthSpan_MSA_Redline_20260921.docx). High-level summary:

1) Payment terms: HealthSpan requested Net45; our standard is Net30. Commercial team to confirm if Net45 is approved for this deal. If yes, we'll accept; otherwise propose Net30 with a conditional Net45 for first two orders.
2) Data retention & logging: We can accept HealthSpan's request for 365-day audit logs, provided Coupa export is automated. We'll need the vendor admin to confirm export cadence.
3) Indemnity cap: proposed change reduces our cap; legal wants to preserve standard liability limits. Need business sign-off if HealthSpan insists.
4) PO acceptance clause: HealthSpan's redline adds a 7-day invoice acceptance window. We prefer the acceptance via system acknowledgement (receipt + PO matching).

Open items for the portal team: please confirm which of the following Coupa fields are required at registration vs optional mapping post-activation:
- remit-to account (bank routing + account)
- tax ID / EIN (required)
- GL code (optional mapping)
- ship-to vs bill-to differentiation
\Kimberly / Vivek: please respond with the portal gating behavior and whether any fields are enforced by Coupa during vendor registration. If we can delay GL mapping to order-time, that will reduce friction.

Jordan: I included inline comments and a redline summary page at the top of the doc. If you can confirm payment terms and audit log cadence, we can finalize a clean MSA + order form for signature.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: HealthSpan_MSA_Redline_20260921.docx (redlines + comments)

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@healthspan.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Coupa gating behavior & GL code enforcement for HealthSpan

Vivek / Kimberly — following Marissa's comments we need a clear answer on portal gating. HealthSpan has asked for minimal friction to register; Marissa is willing to accept deferred GL mapping if registration can succeed without it. Please confirm the following by EOD:

1) Can vendor registration in Coupa complete without a GL code? If yes, is there a later step (order form or EDI) where GL mapping can be supplied?
2) Does Coupa require bank account details (remit-to) to complete activation, or can we accept invoices via API without bank fields on file?
3) If SFTP is used, provide host/path and whether we require fixed folder naming per vendor.

Action items:
- Vivek: provide technical hookup options (API vs SFTP) and minimal required fields for activation.
- Kimberly: confirm if enterprise onboarding will mark vendor as Active in Coupa without GL mapping and what admin permission set is required for HealthSpan to manage remit-to details.

Thanks — I'll coordinate timing with HealthSpan after we get your confirmation.

Michael

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@healthspan.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + MSA redline for Redwood

Michael / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Quick answers from our side:

- HealthSpan can accept Net30 for now. We can revisit Net45 after the first quarter.
- Audit log export: we can schedule daily exports to an SFTP location if you provide host/user.
- GL code: we can leave GL mapping blank at registration and provide mapping at PO issuance if Redwood can accept that flow.
- Bank details: we prefer not to share full bank account until activation; we can provide a masked remit-to reference and submit full details via secure upload once vendor is Active.

Attached: HealthSpan_PO_Mapping.xlsx and a screenshot of our Coupa admin page (Coupa_Admin_Screenshot.png). We accept most of the proposed redline edits except that we'd like the acceptance window language clarified to 5 business days; otherwise proceed.

Are you still available for a 30-minute sync today at 1:00pm PT? If so, please send calendar invite.

Best,
Jordan Lee
Director, Vendor Ops, HealthSpan
procurement@healthspan.com

Attachments: HealthSpan_PO_Mapping.xlsx (xlsx), Coupa_Admin_Screenshot.png (png)
